chk_conclusion.poster_evidence: Channel-aware selection chooses the largest FPR-qualified OR-folded view supported at each reporting opportunity while retaining an unchanged canonical Bloom filter. Across two phishing URL datasets and three channel models, adaptive folding improves communication efficiency and receiver freshness over complete-filter and lossless-compression baselines under Five-State capacity variation and Rayleigh fading. Under Gilbert-Elliott packet loss, it remains competitive in efficiency and produces the freshest receiver state.
